note: 0.6 (Osama, 7 November 2026). Infantry in buildings, Wargame level. Damage that gets through = Damage x (0.18 + 0.82 x IgnoreCover) (ShellHitSystem.DamageBuilding). MLRS HE and thermobaric rockets ignore cover 1.0 (Wargame town damage needs 1.0 or more, calculated from WRD Toolbox HE values). HE bombs ignore cover 0.5. Damage values unchanged. Unguided bombs (Mk82/83/84, FAB, OFAB) lose overpressure (OverpressureRadius 0), so only guided bombs (GBU, KAB) force a roof hit. Penetration is capped so that a direct hit does at most 10 of an MBT's 14 HP: unguided bombs against rear armor 100, guided MLRS against top armor 80 (MLRS keeps overpressure). Penetration = floor(A x sqrt(10 / (Damage - 10))), only where the current value is higher. Cluster, smoke, napalm, incendiary and nuclear rows unchanged. Calculated, not yet run in a game.

mop.note: 0.6 dev.62 (Osama, 8 November 2026): B-2 Spirit 2x GBU-57 MOP loadout +250 (was +400) and the GBU-57 ignores cover 1.0 (was 0.5 from dev.49). Damage, penetration and overpressure unchanged (guided bomb).

fab9000.note: 0.6 dev.66 (Osama, 8 November 2026): FAB-9000 ignores cover 1.0 and has penetration 150 (was 0.5 and 24 from dev.49); still no overpressure. Damage 175 unchanged. Above the dev.49 one-hit cap: a direct hit kills any MBT.

ballistic.note: 0.6 dev.70 (Osama, 8 November 2026): every ballistic missile round (Missile Ballistic: PrSM, Iskander-M HE and cluster, Tochka-U HE and cluster, ATACMS cluster) ignores cover 1.0. Damage and penetration unchanged.

mlrs_note: 0.6 dev.73 (Osama, 8 November 2026): MLRS at about 90% of Wargame per rocket, counting misses. Expected damage per rocket on a point target = peak damage x (blast radius / scatter)^2 x 1/3 (linear falloff) in both games; Wargame scatter is the mean of its min and max dispersion. Wargame stand-ins (WRD Toolbox): Grad M-21OF, Ogon M-14-OF (Shmel), Uragan 9M27F HE, GMLRS/HIMARS M26 HE, 300 mm Uragan-class scatter with HE 15 (Wargame has no Smerch), TOS and CATFAE TOS-1 Buratino. Damage set so BA = 0.9 x Wargame in the open with penetration lowered so a direct roof hit on an MBT (armor 80) does at most about 1.5 HP; ignore cover 0.15 so a building lets 30% through, Wargame's town factor, for every MLRS row (replaces dev.49's 1.0). dev.76 (Osama): TOS-1, TOS-1A and TOS-2 back to vanilla damage 30 and penetration 15 (they don't scatter as much as the model assumed and are already strong), ignore cover 0.15 like the other MLRS. CATFAE is not artillery: removed from the MLRS changes, fully vanilla (damage 30, penetration 15, ignore cover 0). dev.78 (Osama): Grad and Ogon back to vanilla damage (10, 11.5) with FA penetration 45; Uragan and GMLRS kept; GMLRS and HIMARS guided match the unguided GMLRS (35.5 / 17); 300 mm (Smerch, Uragan-S, Kama, Smerch guided, Sarma) scaled from the Uragan and GMLRS factors (x2.47 and x1.97, mean x2.22): 22 -> 49, penetration 14 (MBT roof hit about 1.4 HP). TOS out of the MLRS list (see tos). dev.79 (Osama): each MLRS rocket matches vanilla per hit in the open (damage = vanilla open hit / its low-penetration factor) and does 60% of vanilla in a building (per-row ignore cover; vanilla building rule counted for a 10-man squad). TOS keeps vanilla damage and penetration and the dev.78 scatter, ignore cover 0.059 for 60%. The Ogon (ammo 535, Zubr hovercraft) is out of these changes (Osama: don't touch it). dev.80 (Osama): buildings 50% of vanilla, not 60%: ignore cover recomputed per row. dev.85 (Osama, 9 November 2026: rockets and artillery back to vanilla infantry damage in buildings, ignore cover only): each MLRS row's ignore cover is set so damage x (0.18 + 0.82 x IC) equals vanilla's damage x (0.38 + 0.62 x vanilla IC) for a 10-man squad (FA has no per-soldier term). Damage and penetration unchanged. dev.88 (Osama, 9 November 2026, after his dev.85 editor test: MLRS 'only a hair strong'; 'ONLY touch the ignore cover'): MLRS damage to infantry in buildings x0.8, ignore cover only. New IC = (0.8 x (0.18 + 0.82 x IC) - 0.18) / 0.82. Damage, penetration and open-ground damage unchanged.

tos.note: 0.6 dev.78 (Osama, 8 November 2026): TOS-1, TOS-1A and TOS-2 fully vanilla (damage 30, penetration 15, ignore cover 0) except scatter 50 m wider and longer on the unit card (+25 raw on DispersionHorizontalRadius and DispersionVerticalRadius; card metres = raw x 2). dev.85: ignore cover 0.012 -> 0.244, vanilla infantry damage in buildings (10-man squad). dev.88: ignore cover 0.244 -> 0.151 (80% of dev.85 in buildings). dev.89 (Osama, 9 November 2026: 'crank up the ignore cover to 100%'): ignore cover 0.151 -> 1.0, so infantry in the open, in forest and in buildings take the same damage (30). Damage and penetration unchanged. dev.90 (Osama: 'NOT touch TOS damage to infantry in buildings ... lower the raw damage ... but increase the ignore cover to 100%'): damage 30 -> 9.1 with ignore cover 1.0, so infantry in buildings keep dev.88's 9.1 per hit (30 x (0.18 + 0.82 x 0.151) = 9.11) and the open and forest match it. Damage to vehicles drops the same 70%. Penetration unchanged.
